iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 46. RISING: Iran envoy says not seeking weapons-grade enrichment, BUT nuclear dismantlement was the sticking point in collapsed Islamabad talks. IAEA report: Isfahan tunnel complex still holds uranium from before 2025 strikes. Natanz aboveground destroyed, underground status unknown. 440kg 60% enriched uranium unaccounted for. Iran says negotiators were 'inches away' but failed on nuclear program demands. Technical: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 22%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 46. CRITICAL ESCALATION: US Navy blockade of ALL IRANIAN PORTS begins TODAY (Monday). CENTCOM says won't impede non-Iranian shipping through Hormuz - scaled back from Trump's full blockade threat. Talks collapsed after 21 hrs in Islamabad. Iran says negotiators were 'inches away'. Trump: 'It is all or nothing.' China reportedly planning to help Iran with air-defense weaponry (NBC). Oil surging past $110, spot $141. Iran FM: Hormuz 'will not be opened.' Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 52%. Rising sharply.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 46. ESCALATING: Israel REJECTS ceasefire with Hezbollah ahead of Washington talks next week. Israel struck 100+ targets in 10 minutes - largest wave since March 1. Netanyahu says ceasefire does NOT cover Lebanon. 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. Israel rammed UNIFIL vehicles. Pope Leo XIV demands immediate ceasefire. Hezbollah paused attacks under ceasefire but Israel continues operations. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability UP to 30%. Rising.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opens LARGEST defense production facilities in Turkish history - warhead, missile integration, fuel production. Expanding cruise and ballistic missile capabilities. Nuclear path discussed but gradual. FM Fidan warns of arms race if Iran develops weapons. Akkuyu commissioning. Technical: HIGH. Probability DOWN slightly to 14%. Stable.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: WATCH: CFR survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to 'heightened terrorist activity'. Drivers of conflict from Pakistan remain intact despite ceasefire after May 2025 crisis. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Operation Sindoor aftermath tensions persist. Rhetoric: HIGH. Probability DOWN slightly to 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 51. ESCALATING: Medvedev threatens nuclear weapons against Ukraine and supplier countries. Russia warns Finland will be 'more vulnerable' if it hosts nuclear weapons. NATO: Russia remains 'most significant and direct threat'. Iran war strategic windfall: oil revenues surging billions, sanctions easing. New START expired Feb 2026. Russia shaping narrative ahead of 2026 NPT Review. Probability UP to 58%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: Xi meets KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun, says China will 'absolutely not tolerate' Taiwan independence. Taiwan tracks 'worrying rise' in Chinese naval activity even during peace talks. NBC News: China planning to help Iran with air-defense weaponry - major geopolitical move. 7% defense budget increase. PLA Eastern Theater adding air defense and ASW for amphibious operations. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 24%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 46. SUSTAINED TESTING: 2 consecutive days of missile launches (Apr 7-8). Cluster-bomb warhead ballistic missiles tested. Top diplomat repeats SK is 'most hostile enemy state'. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. ICBM and tactical nukes deployed. Probability 85%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1150+. ESCALATING: Iran war strategic windfall for Russia. Medvedev threatens nuclear weapons. NATO strained by US-European rift over Iran. Ukrainian drone advantage stalling Russian advances - 115 mid-range strikes in March 2026 (up from 41 in Jan). But Russian forces still advancing across multiple sectors. Hormuz blockade spikes oil, further benefiting Russia. New START expired. Probability UP to 79%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: ESCALATING: Pakistan declares 'OPEN WAR' on Afghanistan Taliban regime. Waves of jets striking across disputed border. Fighting entered 5th day. Talks in Urumqi (China) attempting ceasefire. Mortars killing Afghan civilians. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire. Worst conflict since Taliban returned to power in 2021. Probability UP to 18%. Rising.
